athena.directive: Establish designdotmd.directory as the definitive, intelligent platform for design knowledge, fostering creation, discovery, and application of structured design intelligence to empower designers and design teams globally.
athena.rationale: The core mission is to empower designers and teams through structured, accessible, and version-controlled content. This directive encompasses various approaches to achieve that, from curated knowledge to integrated design system tools, ensuring a comprehensive vision for design intelligence.

options.title: The Curated Design Intelligence Hub
options.description: A premium, editorially curated platform featuring best-in-class design practices, frameworks, and case studies from industry leaders. Content is rigorously vetted, structured in Markdown, and version-controlled. It serves as a trusted source for high-quality, actionable design intelligence.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: High perceived value, strong brand reputation, clear path to monetization (subscriptions), less content moderation burden. Cons: Slower content growth, potential for bias in curation, high initial investment in content acquisition/creation, may not cover niche topics adequately.

options.title: The Decentralized Design Knowledge Network
options.description: An open, community-driven platform where designers can contribute, share, and collaboratively evolve design patterns, guidelines, and documentation in Markdown. Emphasizes robust version control, peer review mechanisms, and semantic search. It aims to be the Wikipedia of design knowledge, but with advanced structuring.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Rapid content growth, diverse perspectives, strong community engagement, low content creation cost. Cons: Significant moderation challenges, potential for quality inconsistencies, complex governance model, requires robust anti-spam/vandalism measures.

options.title: The Integrated Design System Documentation Engine
options.description: A platform that not only hosts structured Markdown content but also integrates deeply with design tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch) and development workflows (e.g., Storybook, code repositories). It enables automated generation and synchronization of design system documentation, ensuring consistency between design, code, and content.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Solves a critical pain point for design systems, high value proposition for enterprise users, strong differentiation, potential for high-value integrations. Cons: High technical complexity, requires extensive API integrations, steeper learning curve for users, potential vendor lock-in with specific tools.

options.title: The AI-Powered Design Discovery & Learning Assistant
options.description: A personalized platform that leverages AI to understand a designer's role, project context, and skill gaps, then intelligently recommends relevant design articles, tutorials, patterns, and tools from a vast knowledge base (internal and external sources). Content is structured Markdown, but the primary value is in smart discovery.
options.tradeoffs: Pros: Highly personalized user experience, strong engagement potential, leverages cutting-edge technology, addresses information overload. Cons: Requires significant AI/ML investment, data privacy concerns, 'cold start' problem for recommendations, dependence on external content sources.
